name: quorum
description: Multi-agent deliberation CLI in Claude Code. Wraps the `quorum` binary with smart prompts, `.env` auto-detection, post-run diagnosis, and a session-start tip that surfaces orchestrator + agent health before the operator types a single command. Slash commands: /quorum:init, /quorum:redeem, /quorum:run, /quorum:serve, /quorum:status, /quorum:trace, /quorum:validate, /quorum:tui.
